items.definition:
a vegetable (informal)
Make sure you eat your veggies.

a thin stick
The magician waved his magic wand.

an advertisement
I saw an advert for a new car.

the state of being bored
She suffered from extreme boredom during the long lecture.

a late morning meal
We're going out for brunch on Sunday.

chemistry (informal)
I have a big chem test tomorrow.

a glossy brown nut; a reddish-brown color
We roasted chestnuts over an open fire.

the act of making something clean and tidy
The cleanup after the party took hours.

a conversation between two or more people
The play had very witty dialog.

a person or thing that supplies food; a tributary
We put out a bird feeder in the garden.

a person who draws or creates pictures for books, magazines, etc.
The book's illustrator did a wonderful job with the pictures.

a major road for fast-moving traffic, especially in the UK
We drove along the motorway to reach the city faster.

a long, flat piece of wood
We walked the plank to cross the stream.

a flat buoyant structure of timber or other materials for conveying people or things by water
They built a raft to cross the river.

a plant grown for its seeds, which are used in cooking
The bread was topped with sesame seeds.

a strong, unpleasant smell
There was a terrible stink coming from the garbage.

a public transport vehicle running on rails, typically powered by electricity
We took the tram to the city center.

a short, high sound
The microwave made a loud beep when the food was ready.

a person who looks after a building or person
The school caretaker is responsible for locking up at night.

a list of items to be checked
Before leaving, make sure you go through the packing checklist.

a female emperor or the wife of an emperor
The empress ruled the vast empire for many years.

the celebration of something in a joyful way
The town was filled with festivity during the annual carnival.

a sudden, usually temporary malfunction or irregularity
There was a minor glitch in the software update.

a metallic disc that produces a resonant sound when struck
The sound of the gong signaled the start of the ceremony.

a person who grades papers; a machine for leveling ground
The teacher spent hours as a grader, marking essays.

a circular band or ring
He shot the basketball through the hoop.

a small arm of the sea, lake, or river that extends into the land
The boat sailed into a narrow inlet, sheltered from the wind.

an inhabitant of an island
The islanders rely on fishing for their livelihood.

a Scottish lake or sea inlet
Loch Ness is famous for its monster.

a furry growth of minute fungi occurring on organic matter
There was mould growing on the old bread.

a strong, unpleasant smell
There was a terrible pong coming from the drains.

an earthquake or tremor
The small quake rattled the windows.

a person, animal, or vehicle that races
The Formula 1 racer sped around the track.

a summary or brief review
Let's do a quick recap of what we discussed.

The part of a tree remaining in the ground after it has been cut down
We sat on the tree stump by the river.

The amount of work to be done
My workload has increased significantly this month.

the state of being unable to see
She has suffered from partial blindness since birth.

a small, yellow songbird
The canary sang a beautiful tune from its cage.

cardiovascular exercise
I do cardio for 30 minutes every morning.

a person who travels some distance to work on a regular basis
Many commuters rely on public transport to get to the city center.

the darker stage of twilight
The streetlights came on at dusk.

a male godparent; a man who is influential in a particular sphere
My uncle is my godfather.

grandmother (informal)
My gran always bakes the best cookies.

a sharp blow with a whip or cord; an eyelash
She has long, dark lashes.

a small aromatic evergreen shrub; a pale purple color
The garden was filled with the scent of lavender.

the offspring of a donkey and a mare
The farmer used a mule to pull the cart.

a person who has recently arrived in a place or started an activity
The village welcomed the newcomers with a party.

a large male pheasant with a crested head and fan-like tail
The peacock displayed its beautiful tail feathers.

A set of printed or written questions with a choice of answers, devised for the purposes of a survey or statistical study
Please fill out this questionnaire before the interview.

A second or return match between the same opponents
The two boxers agreed to a rematch next month.

A question or statement intentionally phrased so as to require ingenuity in ascertaining its answer or meaning
Can you solve this riddle?

A cockroach
I saw a roach scuttling across the kitchen floor.

A precious gemstone, typically blue
She wore a beautiful sapphire ring.

a marine cephalopod
We ordered fried squid as an appetizer.

a book published annually by a school or college
She signed her friends' yearbooks on the last day of school.

a rounded, bushy hairstyle
He proudly wore his large afro.

a light bluish-green color
The swimming pool had beautiful aqua tiles.

an injury appearing as an area of discolored skin on the body
He had a large bruise on his arm after falling.

a chemical element used to purify water
The swimming pool smelled strongly of chlorine.

a musical composition for two performers
They sang a beautiful duet together.

violin; a dishonest act
He played a lively tune on his fiddle.

a cheap hotel for travelers
We stayed in a youth hostel during our trip to Europe.

a stretch of salt water separated from the sea by a low sandbank or coral reef
The boat sailed into the calm lagoon.

the period of the year when a particular sport or activity is not in full swing
During the offseason, many athletes focus on training.
